canonical.name: Mkt-RF

lookback.meaning: realized holding interval, not predictive lookback

korean_adaptation.name: KR_MKT_TR and KR_MKT_EXCESS
korean_adaptation.formula: R_m,t = TR_index_t / TR_index_(t-1) - 1; EXCESS_t = R_m,t - RF_KRW,t
differences: Korean benchmark universe/currency and risk-free convention
KOSPI and KOSDAQ TR benchmarks kept separate; market-wide aggregate requires documented historical weights

orientation.meaning: exposure/explanation control, not a high-versus-low stock ranking

factors.hypothesis_ko: 시장 공통 움직임과 개별 종목 신호의 기여를 분리한다. 시장 수익 자체가 횡단면 알파 증거는 아니다.
input_requirements: certified daily/monthly market TR index and constituents/methodology
KRW risk-free holding-period return and day-count convention
same currency and holding interval as stock labels
measurement_requirements: Never call a price index a TR index

Realized t+1 market returns may explain t+1 returns ex post but cannot predict t+1 at time t

blockers: V3 certified market TR and RF artifacts not bound
existing regime index is not automatically a certified TR benchmark

separate size exposure from actual trading capacity/cost
